args.query: SELECT p.product_number, p.make_flag, p.safety_stock_level FROM products p JOIN subcategories s ON p.subcategory_id=s.subcategory_id JOIN categories c ON c.category_id=s.category_id WHERE c.name='Components'
SELECT part_ref, vendor_id, average_lead_time FROM vendor_items

import json,pandas as pd
def L(v): return json.load(open(v)) if isinstance(v,str) else v
p=pd.DataFrame(L(var_call_1)); s=pd.DataFrame(L(var_call_2)); v=pd.DataFrame(L(var_call_3))
out={}
out['mf']=list(map(str,p.make_flag.unique())); out['np']=len(p)
out['nonaw']=[x for x in s['_id'] if not x.startswith('AW:')][:20]
out['oddv']=[x for x in v.part_ref.unique() if x!=x.strip().upper()][:20]
def n(x): return x.strip().upper().replace('_','-').replace('AW:','')
s['k']=s['_id'].map(n); s['q']=s.q.astype(float)
sq=s.groupby('k').q.sum()
v['k']=v.part_ref.map(n); v['lt']=v.average_lead_time.astype(float)
vl=v.groupby('k').lt.min()
pp=p[p.make_flag.astype(str)=='0'].copy(); pp['k']=pp.product_number.map(n)
pp['qty']=pp.k.map(sq).fillna(0); pp['ss']=pp.safety_stock_level.astype(float)
pp['lt']=pp.k.map(vl)
r=pp[pp.qty<pp.ss]
out['npp']=len(pp); out['r']=r[['product_number','qty','ss','lt']].values.tolist()
out['nostock']=pp[pp.k.map(lambda k:k not in sq.index)].product_number.tolist()

Six purchased Components (make_flag 0) have less stock on hand, summed across all locations, than their safety stock level. Each has a safety stock level of 500.

| Product number | Total on hand | Shortest average vendor lead time (days) |
|---|---|---|
| SE-M798 | 422 | 15 |
| SE-M940 | 355 | 17 |
| SE-R995 | 467 | 15 |
| SE-T762 | 402 | 15 |
| PD-R347 | 498 | 16 |
| PD-R563 | 494 | 16 |

The warehouse and purchasing systems write item codes differently from the product master (an "AW:" prefix in warehouse stock, underscores instead of hyphens in vendor items), so I converted them to the product-master form to match records. All 19 purchased Components had warehouse stock records, so none were missed. The lead times include every vendor that lists the item, whether or not the vendor is active.
